title: My last weekend
prompt: Write 5 or 6 sentences about what you did last weekend. Use the past simple.
model: Last weekend I visited my cousin. We cooked lunch together and then we watched a film. On Sunday I studied English for two hours.
promptSo: Qor 5 ama 6 jumladood oo ku saabsan wixii aad samaysay dhammaadkii toddobaadkii hore. Adeegso waqti-falka tagay ee fudud (past simple).

title: Is social media good for students?
prompt: Give your opinion in a short paragraph. Give two reasons and one example.
model: I think social media can help students because they can share notes and ask questions quickly. However, it can also waste time. For example, I sometimes spend an hour on my phone instead of studying.
promptSo: Ku muuji ra’yigaaga faqrado gaaban. Bixi laba sababood iyo hal tusaale.
modelSo: Waxaan qabaa in baraha bulshada ay ardayda caawin karaan sababtoo ah si dhakhso ah ayay qoraallo waxbarasho u wadaagi karaan su’aalana isu weydiin karaan. Hase yeeshee, waxay sidoo kale lumin karaan waqtiga. Tusaale ahaan, mararka qaarkood saacad ayaan telefoonka ku lumiyaa halkii aan wax ku baran lahaa.

title: Complain about a late delivery
prompt: Write a formal email to a company about an order that arrived two weeks late. Say what happened and what you want them to do.
model: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about order 4471, which arrived two weeks after the promised date. I would appreciate a partial refund. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, A. Ali

title: Should cities ban private cars?
prompt: Write a balanced essay. Present arguments for and against, then give your conclusion.
model: Proponents argue that banning private cars would reduce pollution and congestion. However, such a ban could harm people who depend on cars for work or mobility. On balance, restricting cars in the centre while improving public transport seems the most workable approach.
promptSo: Qor maqaal dheellitiran. Soo bandhig doodaha taageersan iyo kuwa ka soo horjeeda, dabadeedna bixi gunaanadkaaga.
modelSo: Taageerayaashu waxay ku doodaan in mamnuucidda baabuurta gaarka loo leeyahay ay yarayn lahayd wasakhowga iyo ciriiriga waddooyinka. Hase yeeshee, mamnuucidda noocaas ahi waxay dhibaato u keeni kartaa dadka shaqadooda ama dhaqdhaqaaqooda ugu baahan baabuur. Marka la isu miisaamo, xaddididda baabuurta bartamaha magaalada iyadoo la hagaajinayo gaadiidka dadweynaha ayaa u muuqata xalka ugu macquulsan.

title: A reflective piece on learning a language
prompt: Reflect on what learning a language has taught you beyond vocabulary and grammar. Use a clear structure and a varied range of sentence patterns.
model: Learning a language has taught me humility: for months I was unable to express even simple ideas, and that experience changed how I listen to others.
promptSo: Ka fiirso waxa barashada luqaddu ku bartay ee ka baxsan eray-bixinta iyo naxwaha. Adeegso qaab-dhismeed cad iyo jumlado kala nooc ah.
